Challenge
Tasks
Marketing
Building PoultryCare and MaayaERP brands. Lead and channel performance unmeasured.
Clear positioning for both products and one proven acquisition channel.
Trusted brands with repeat business, referrals and an active customer community.
Marketing owner: reuse 5 CSAT interviews; approve 2 product messages by 31 Jan. Publish 1 approved customer story and test 1 channel by 28 Feb. Track qualified leads for 4 weeks.
Test one channel at a time within an agreed budget. Reuse customer interviews.
Sales
25 paid customers. Conversion, churn and delivery capacity unmeasured.
Set a capacity-backed customer target by 31 Jan. Keep 250 as a stretch ambition.
Work toward 6,000 customers; review retention, economics and service capacity annually.
Sales owner: record every active deal, owner and next step by 15 Dec. Review weekly for 20 minutes. Use 6 weeks of sales and delivery data to set the annual target by 31 Jan.
250 requires 225 net additions, about 19 monthly. Validate demand and onboarding capacity first.
Onboarding
Onboarding time, milestones and ownership need a baseline.
Use a standard checklist for every customer; measure time to first useful workflow.
Teams and partners deliver consistent onboarding within clear capacity limits.
Onboarding owner: document one product checklist by 15 Dec. Test on the next 3 customers; record completion times. Review available cases and set a provisional service target by 31 Jan.
Check customer data and training readiness. Limit concurrent starts to available capacity.
Support
Request volume, response time and escalation ownership unmeasured.
Every request has an owner, priority and response commitment within service hours.
A capable support team resolves routine issues without founder involvement.
Support owner: establish one queue, service hours and escalation rules by 15 Dec. Measure demand for 4 weeks. Publish 3 help articles and set response targets by 31 Jan.
Match coverage to demand. Avoid making the founder the default on-call contact.
CSAT
Customer feedback, response rates and churn reasons need a baseline.
Review feedback quarterly; track follow-ups and improvement against the baseline.
Sustained customer outcomes, retention and voluntary referrals.
Customer success owner: interview 5 customers by 30 Nov; record responses. Assign owners and deadlines to the top 3 issues by 15 Dec. Check outcomes with customers by 31 Jan.
Five interviews guide priorities, not a representative CSAT score. Fix service gaps before scaling.
Product Dev
PoultryCare and MaayaERP underway; TexoPi, Maaya.works and TruePi compete for capacity.
Deliver a focused core roadmap. Start at most one funded, customer-validated pilot.
Expand into selected industries through validated products and reusable components.

Product owner: rank 10 requests by impact and effort by 31 Jan. Deliver at most 2 improvements with agreed acceptance checks by 28 Feb. Require an owner, time budget and customer validation for any pilot.
New-product work must fit team capacity and protected personal time. Pause work that displaces core commitments.
HRD
15-person team with new processes. Role playbooks planned.
Clear roles and capable function owners. Hire toward 25 only for affordable, measured gaps.
Build leadership capacity; treat 200 staff as a demand-dependent ambition.
People owner: assign existing owners to all 9 functions by 30 Nov. Complete 3 priority role playbooks and coach each owner by 31 Jan. Review workload before hiring by 28 Feb.
One person may own several functions. Check cash and training capacity before hiring.
Finance
Revenue, margins, cash and receivables not supplied.
Close monthly by the 10th working day. Maintain a 13-week cash view and product costs.
Fund sustainable growth with clear product economics and disciplined investment.
Finance owner: prepare a 13-week cash forecast by 30 Nov; update weekly through January. Set spending and hiring approval limits by 15 Dec. Close December by January’s 10th working day.
Confirm affordability before hiring, marketing or pilots. Keep personal withdrawals separate.
Management
Building systems and culture. Work pressure interrupts personal priorities.
Delegate routine operations; reduce founder hours and interruptions against a baseline.
Routine operations continue through a 2-week founder absence.
Founder: by 31 Oct, reserve a 45-minute weekly review, 2 family blocks and three 30-minute personal blocks weekly. Log work for 2 weeks by 15 Nov. Delegate 2 decisions by 30 Nov; review fortnightly.
Limit improvements to 3 active projects. Prioritise feedback, cash and delegation. Queue other work; defer a project after 2 weeks of missed personal blocks.
